facts.business: Nesco Limited is a diversified conglomerate operating an integrated campus in Goregaon, Mumbai (Nesco Center) combining commercial real estate, exhibitions, events, and hospitality, along with engineering manufacturing (Indabrator) in Gujarat and wayside amenities on expressways.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex investments in specific technologies to improve environmental and social impacts

auditor.name: S G D G & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No observations were reported in the audit report.

key_risks: Risk of delays, cost overruns or rework in the multi-year capex cycle, deferring commercialisation and tying up capital
Competition Risk: Sensitivity of leasing demand, event spend and exhibition footfall to economic cycles, alongside intensifying competition from new venues and commercial real estate stock
Health, Safety and Operations Risk: Safety risks for employees, contractors and visitors across high-footfall venues, kitchens, manufacturing facilities and highway sites
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions (RPTs) entered into during the financial year under review were conducted in its ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. All RPTs had prior approval of the Audit Committee.
